**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **§12.3** affirmatively confirms Customer is unrestricted as to products it may develop, acquire, license, sell or use, suppliers it may engage, and fields/territories in which it may operate, and records that no exclusivity or non-compete commitment has been given — this is the playbook's preferred position.
- **§13.4** contains only standard use restrictions (no reverse engineering, no interference, no unlawful use), which are not field-of-use or competitive restraints.
- **§12.4** restricts Vendor from developing a service competing with our analytics products — a restraint on the counterparty that benefits us, so it is not flagged.
